test_name: Verify Search Functionality in Event Management
description: Tests the ability of a user to search for specific events in the Event Management dashboard and verify that the results match the search criteria.
steps: Verify that the page loads correctly and the search bar is visible.
Click on the search bar identified by the selector '[data-testid="events-search-box"].
Wait for the results to load on the page.
Verify that the displayed events include 'test-event-123' in the event name or details.
Verify that no unrelated events are displayed in the results.
Clear the search input field and verify that the full list of events is displayed again.
expected_results: Matching search results appear based on the input query.
No unrelated events are displayed in the search results.
Clearing the search field restores the full list of events.
edge_cases: Search with a very long string.
Search immediately after clearing the search bar.
data_requirements: At least one event named 'test-event-123' exists in the system.
A list of other events for testing unrelated results.
Access to the Event Management dashboard.
Valid user credentials for accessing the dashboard.
Clear instructions for search input format.
dependencies: Event Management page must be accessible.
User must be logged in and authorized.
Test environment must be loaded with test data.
No ongoing backend issues affecting search.
api_interactions: API call to fetch event data based on search query.
API call to load default event list when search is cleared.
performance_metrics: API response time for search query is under 1 second.
No noticeable UI lags during typing in the search bar.
accessibility_requirements: Search bar must be navigable using the Tab key.
Search results must be screen-reader accessible.
Proper ARIA roles must be defined for the search bar and results.
